pages.text: The Lover is the main way Risus affects non-sentient living creatures. It ignores people and targets creatures such as Creepers or Spiders, even Endermen. Once it touches them with the oozing postules on its body, it forcefully impregnates them with the Risus. This causes a violent reaction, where the victim's body is oftentimes torn open in the process. Drops $(l:materials/lovers_cream)$(c)$(o)Lover's Cream$() when killed.
Even though they are passive towards people, letting them be can be very dangerous.

pages.title: Addendum
pages.text: Honestly speaking, Lovers are genuinely my favorite. They are great specimens to use for experiments as they can be leashed, they float - meaning they can traverse any type of terrain - and pose virtually no direct danger. They even like flowers! I would definitely prefer keeping a Lover as a pet over any other monster. Even if its looks are horrendous, I can just get used to it with time. No issues!

$(o)Note: Re-reading this addendum, I realize it comes across sounding a bit insane despite any such intentions. It was simply written right after the frustration of a Holder stealing an item of mine again, so I inadvertently included more unfiltered emotions than I should have.
